name: @pipeworx/mcp-allen-brain

tools.name: allen_search_genes
tools.description: Look up genes in the Allen Brain Atlas gene catalog by symbol/acronym, name substring, or Entrez ID. AUTHORITATIVE for resolving a gene to the Allen internal gene id and organism that the atlas expression data is keyed on — note the atlas holds mouse and human as SEPARATE gene records with the same-but-differently-cased acronym (Gabra1 vs GABRA1), and the expression datasets attached to each differ. Use this before allen_expression_datasets.

acronym.description: Exact gene symbol, e.g. "Gabra1" (mouse) or "GABRA1" (human). Case matters for the exact match; matching is retried case-insensitively and the response says which casing hit.

name_contains.description: Substring of the gene name, e.g. "dopamine receptor". Case-insensitive.

organism.description: Filter results to "mouse", "human", or omit for both.

tools.name: allen_structures
tools.description: Query the Allen Brain Atlas structure ontology — the canonical hierarchy of named brain regions (Field CA1, Primary visual area, Substantia nigra) with their acronyms, colors, parent structure, and full root-to-leaf structure_id_path. AUTHORITATIVE for resolving a brain-region name or acronym to the structure ID that Allen expression, connectivity and reference-space data are annotated against, and for establishing whether one region contains another.

name_contains.description: Substring of the structure name, e.g. "hippocamp", "visual area". Case-insensitive.

graph_id.description: Structure graph to search. 1 = adult mouse brain (default), 10 = human brain, 17 = developing mouse.

tools.name: allen_expression_datasets
tools.description: List the Allen Brain Atlas in-situ hybridization expression experiments (SectionDataSets) for a gene — which atlas product they belong to (Mouse Brain, Developing Mouse, Human Brain, Mouse Spinal Cord), plane of section (coronal/sagittal), section thickness, and the dataset id used to fetch images and per-structure expression. AUTHORITATIVE for "where in the brain is gene X expressed" and for finding the experiment ids behind an Allen expression figure.

gene_acronym.description: Gene symbol, e.g. "Gabra1" (mouse) or "GABRA1" (human). Casing selects the species record; both are tried and the response says which matched.

plane_of_section.description: Optional filter: "coronal" or "sagittal". Omit for both — filtering can empty an otherwise non-empty result.

product_id.description: Optional Allen product id filter (1 = Mouse Brain ISH, 3 = Developing Mouse Brain). Omit unless you need one product; the response always reports the unfiltered total.

include_failed.description: Include experiments Allen flagged as failed QC (default false).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-allen-brain forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the allen-brain pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
